reason: The plugin is primarily an orchestration utility for DeepSeek Harness sessions: it routes work across think/build/vision model tiers, adds `/omd` controls and agent tools, and provides optional vision-to-text and image-generation flows, while applying guard and escalation rules for certain risky actions in build mode. Evidence from the repository description, README, and package manifest consistently identifies it as a workflow-routing and model-management plugin.

summaries.zh: oh-my-dsh 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供思考/构建层级路由与 /omd 控制，支持图片场景自动转交 vision 描述和图片生成功能，以便在会话中按场景切换模型。
summaries.en: oh-my-dsh is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds think/build model-tier routing with /omd controls, plus vision delegation and image-generation flows to switch model behavior per session workflow.

capabilities: Vision model delegation for image-to-text flow
Session-aware slash commands and agent tools

reasons.code: README states sessions can switch between think/build/vision behavior via /omd commands and omd_* tools, and supports per-session tier mode selection.
README describes vision delegation where images are described in the background and later substituted in history for text-only models, plus image generation via configured chat models.
Package metadata and README indicate external model providers are configured in settings and used by the plugin, including API key handling for image providers.

capabilities: Vision model delegation for image-to-text flow
